items.text: Sokoto Command (HIGH CONTROL - SPS: 8.1): Sokoto police operatives storm bandit hideout, rescue two hostages and burn camps.
Anambra Command (HIGH CONTROL - SPS: 7.9): Anambra police arrest five suspects, recover remains and ransom in murder case.
Katsina Command (HIGH CONTROL - SPS: 7.8): Katsina police burst cyber fraud syndicate, arrest five suspects and secure bank freezes.
Ondo Command (HIGH CONTROL - SPS: 7.6): Ondo police bust counterfeit dollar printing factory in Odigbo, arresting one suspect.
Ekiti Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.4): Ekiti police arrest armed robbery suspect, recover stolen motorcycles and a firearm.
Osun Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.4): Osun State Command assures NYSC of adequate security for corps members.
Akwa Ibom Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.4): Akwa Ibom police arrest drug suspects and masquerades in separate intelligence operations.
Kwara Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.4): Kwara joint security operation exposes kidnapping syndicate, arresting three suspects.
Cross River Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.2): Cross River police foil vehicle theft, recovering stolen Toyota Camry as suspect flees.
Ogun Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.2): Ogun police present welfare cheques to families of fallen heroes under IGP scheme.
Gombe Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.3): Gombe police arrest suspected cable vandal, recovering four rolls of high-tension cables.
Jigawa Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.3): Jigawa CP decorates newly promoted officers, charging them with professional accountability.
Ebonyi Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.1): Ebonyi police arrest fake lawyer practicing for more than eleven years.
Lagos Command (ACTIVE - SPS: 7.1): Lagos police sensitize students against social vices and distribute exercise books in Ajao Estate.
Abia Command (HIGH CONTROL - SPS: 7): Abia police apprehend suspect for unlawful possession of firearm in Ikwuano.
Enugu Command (HIGH CONTROL - SPS: 7): Enugu police secure conviction of woman for child stealing and conspiracy.
Bauchi Command (MODERATE CONTROL - SPS: 6.9): Bauchi police arrest two drug peddlers in Yelwa, recovering Tramadol and other narcotics.
Oyo Command (MODERATE CONTROL - SPS: 6.9): Oyo police arraign two suspects over corpse desecration and defamatory social media publications.
Bayelsa Command (MODERATE CONTROL - SPS: 6.8): Bayelsa police arrest three suspects for tampering with public asset in Otuabagi.
Kano Command (MODERATE CONTROL - SPS: 6.8): Kano police commemorate CRU anniversary with community outreach to orphanage and hospitals.
